verdict.rationale: Bun's docs say v1.2 made the text-based `bun.lock` the default lockfile, and `bun install` creates it. A dedicated lockfile docs page exists, and the homepage advertises "a lockfile you can read," so the core of an agent-readable, diffable lockfile is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented schema/format specification of `bun.lock`'s structure, explicit guidance on diffing lockfile changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can parse and diff it reliably.
